basic_info.description: A Light-Filled Top Floor Sanctuary in Pacific Heights. This sun-drenched top-floor Condo blends effortless modern living with timeless elegance. Designed for those who crave both style, this home sparkles with bespoke finishes, natural light at every turn, and a location that puts San Francisco's most romantic experiences at your doorstep. Step inside soaring ceilings and skylights that make this home feel open, airy, and alive with energy. Whether you're curling up with a book, hosting girlfriends for wine night, or unwinding after a day of shopping on Sacramento Street, this is a space that feels both elevated and inviting. The kitchen is as chic as it is functional, featuring bespoke cabinetry, high-end appliances, and luminous stone counters. The primary bedroom offers a tranquil escape, designed to feel like a boutique hotel suite. Soft light and luxurious details create the perfect balance of beauty and practicality. Every thoughtful detailfrom in-unit laundry to top-floor privacymakes life just easier. And beyond your front door, you're just steps away from Alta Plaza Park's sweeping views, Fillmore's world-class dining, and Sacramento Street's chic boutiques. This is more than a condo, this is your Sanctuary.
